title: UAAP: UP women pull away from La Salle to keep Final 4 hopes alive
summary: University of the Philippines fueled its Final 4 hopes in the UAAP Season 89 women's basketball tournament after a 92-74 triumph over De La Salle University on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum.
